name: Small Business Marketing Tools

sources.title: Tools Directory Listings page (search-indexed; site 403s automated fetches) — two listing types, Enhanced (with logo, newsletter promo, bonus listing on MarineMarketingTools.com) then Basic; editorial approval; 'payment will be requested via credit card'
Advertise page (search-indexed) — 'low annual rates' for directory listings; sponsored articles also offered

Homepage — marketing/productivity tools guide for small businesses; directory categories: advertising, branding, direct marketing, marketing plans, PR, social media, websites, small business resources (403 to bots)

requirements: Product must be a marketing or business-productivity tool aimed at small businesses (directories: Advertising, Branding & Graphics, Direct Marketing, Marketing Plans, PR, Social Media, Websites, Small Business Resources)
Editorial approval required — 'Advertiser will be notified of any necessary edits before insertion'
Payment by credit card at submission; Enhanced tier adds logo upload, monthly e-newsletter mention, and a bonus listing on sister site MarineMarketingTools.com
The site's stated theme is free or low-cost tools — expensive enterprise products likely won't fit editorially
preparation: Tool name, URL, description, target category
Credit card for the listing fee
Positioning as 'free or low-cost' for small businesses
workflow: Choose the category directory that fits (e.g., Social Media tools)
Submit listing information on the tools-directory-listings page — payment is requested by credit card on submission
Respond to any editorial edits they send back
Listing goes live in the category page; Enhanced gets a newsletter mention the following month
watchFor: All listing types appear to cost money ('low annual rates', credit card on submit) — no free tier was found
Rank order favors Enhanced listings, then seniority — a Basic listing sits at the bottom
Site is dated (launched 2011); verify it's still maintained before paying
Site blocks bots (403) — complete the process in a normal browser
countsAsLive: The tool appears on its category directory page (e.g., /marketing-tools-directory/<category>-tools/) on sbmarketingtools.com
unknowns: Exact annual price for Basic vs Enhanced (not visible in indexed content)
Current maintenance/activity level of the site
